# Neuroarchitectures

> The open community for the Neural Architecture Exchange Specification (NAXS) — a vendor-independent, framework-agnostic JSON format for describing neural network architectures as directed graphs of typed, parameterized components.

Docs:

- Homepage: https://neuroarchitectures.github.io
- Quickstart — author your first NAXS document: https://neuroarchitectures.github.io/quickstart
- Examples gallery: https://neuroarchitectures.github.io/examples
- Specification — complete NAXS 0.1 reference: https://neuroarchitectures.github.io/specification/introduction
- Quick Reference Card: https://neuroarchitectures.github.io/specification/quick-reference
- Document Structure (§4–§6): https://neuroarchitectures.github.io/specification/document-structure
- Operator Type Registry (§7): https://neuroarchitectures.github.io/specification/operator-registry
- Graph Model (§8, §12): https://neuroarchitectures.github.io/specification/graph-model
- Metadata & Provenance (§9–§11): https://neuroarchitectures.github.io/specification/metadata-and-provenance
- Validation (§13, §21): https://neuroarchitectures.github.io/specification/validation
- Annotated Examples (§14–§19): https://neuroarchitectures.github.io/specification/annotated-examples
- Conformance (§20, §22–§24): https://neuroarchitectures.github.io/specification/conformance
- Block Templates & Repetition (§25): https://neuroarchitectures.github.io/specification/block-templates
- Appendices: https://neuroarchitectures.github.io/specification/appendices
- Community & contributing: https://neuroarchitectures.github.io/community

Optional:

- NAXS specification source: https://github.com/neuroarchitectures/naxs/blob/main/specification.md
- Reference Python validator (pynaxs): https://github.com/neuroarchitectures/naxs/tree/main/pynaxs
- JSON Schema: https://github.com/neuroarchitectures/naxs/blob/main/naxs/v0.1/schema.json
